notes.title: Enhanced Memory CG Switching & Replay Feature!
notes.notes:
[p]Fulfilled the long-awaited request of many players:

After entering a memory fragment, players can seamlessly switch between CGs using the Left/Right Arrow Keys (↔️), Mouse Scroll Wheel (↕️), or Right Mouse Button to close,
ensuring a smooth and intuitive experience with full keyboard and mouse support.
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/d83a4c101be5645881d18e216d3e2d33f78d0903.jpg"][/img]Additionally, on-screen buttons have been added for returning and switching between CGs.

The Replay feature has also been introduced, currently featuring only Oni’s Replay, with more character replays to be added in future updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/c1175477b62fba4aef37420e6fe0d4fc634675db.jpg"][/img]

Don't mind Oba's simple UI—what matters is making the gameplay experience great! In gaming, flavor and aroma are king, while appearance is secondary.

[/p]
